01 · about

About Me

I'm an undergraduate reading for a BICT (Information and Communication Technology) degree at the University of Vavuniya, expected to graduate in 2026. My interest is in how good analysis and design decisions — not just code — make software genuinely usable.

I enjoy front-end development, working through real problems with structured methods (like the System Analysis and Design process behind this very site), and picking up new tools quickly. Outside of coursework, I like exploring open-source projects on GitHub and improving my problem-solving through small personal builds.

Career objective: to secure an internship or entry-level role in software / web development where I can apply my ICT training, keep learning modern tools, and grow into a reliable, detail-oriented developer.

BICT — Bachelor of Information and Communication Technology
